items.title: Rebuild Missing Files shows 'No archive found' for mods that genuinely have an archive on disk
items.why: A lot of mods are showing as missing their archive when the file is clearly sitting in the downloads folder — likely a version mismatch (collection.json expects a different version than what's downloaded) getting reported as if the file were simply absent.
items.prompt:
MANDATORY LIVE DEBUGGING against the director's own real data — do not theory-patch blind. Rebuild Missing Files is showing 'No archive file found' / 'Can't check without the archive' for a LOT of mods that genuinely have an archive sitting in the downloads folder at the expected path (confirmed live: 'FlufyFox Animations for OStim Standalone', archive visibly present at `F:\Vortex Downloads\skyrimse\FlufyFox Animations for OStim Standalone-163176-2-0-0-1775686571.7z`, mod shows Enabled in Vortex itself). Not an isolated case — director confirmed 'there are a lot of missing archives'.

GROUNDING (read `lib/archive-locator.js` before touching anything): `locateArchive` is completely filename-agnostic — it matches candidates purely by exact fileSize, then md5, against `mod.source.fileSize`/`mod.source.md5` as recorded in the COLLECTION's own `collection.json`. It throws `NOT_FOUND` (no file within size tolerance) or `HASH_MISMATCH` (a same-size file exists but its md5 doesn't match) — `classifyMod` (lib/rebuild-mod.js) maps BOTH of these to the same friendly 'No archive file found.' detail text, so a `SKIP_NO_ARCHIVE` result on screen does NOT necessarily mean the file is literally absent from disk — it could mean collection.json expects a DIFFERENT version (different md5/fileSize) than whatever's actually downloaded.

STRONG LEAD, VERIFY BEFORE TRUSTING: this may be a genuine, if confusing, version-mismatch — the collection was updated (a newer archive version now recorded in collection.json) but the downloads folder still only has an OLDER version of the same mod's archive. This is a real, expected-in-principle situation this tool has to handle gracefully, not necessarily a bug in the matching logic itself.

INVESTIGATE, using the director's real environment (ask them to run/check, or do it yourself if you have access):
1. For the 'FlufyFox Animations for OStim Standalone' mod specifically: read this collection's `collection.json`, find this mod's entry, note its recorded `source.fileSize` and `source.md5`.
2. Compute the REAL file's actual size and md5 for `F:\Vortex Downloads\skyrimse\FlufyFox Animations for OStim Standalone-163176-2-0-0-1775686571.7z` (Node's crypto, or certutil).
3. Compare. If they genuinely differ, this confirms the version-mismatch theory — the fix is a BETTER, more honest message than 'No archive file found' for this specific case (e.g. 'An archive for this mod exists, but it's a different version than this collection expects — a newer/older version may have been downloaded since. Try Download Archive to get the exact version needed, or update your collection.').
4. If they're IDENTICAL (same size, same md5) and `locateArchive` STILL failed to find it, that's a genuine code bug — dig into why (are archive extensions being filtered correctly? Is `downloadsDir` actually pointing at `F:\Vortex Downloads\skyrimse`? Log the actual candidates `findCandidates` returns and why none matched).
5. Given the director says this affects 'a lot' of mods, check whether this whole collection was recently updated in Vortex (would explain a WIDESPREAD version-mismatch across many mods at once, not a scattered one-off).

FIX whatever the real data shows. If it's the version-mismatch case, prioritize a clear, honest message over silently misleading 'No archive file found' — the director should be able to tell 'genuinely missing' apart from 'wrong version downloaded' at a glance.

VERIFY: re-scan the same collection after the fix, confirm the message/behavior is now accurate for this mod and ideally a few of the other affected ones. Handoff with the real md5/fileSize comparison you found — don't report this fixed without showing the actual numbers.

items.title: ESLifier awareness — Settings path + Missing Masters downgrade
items.why: kills the false-positive 'missing master' when ESLifier deliberately swapped a file
items.prompt: Read vortex-tools/vortex-collection-tools/design/BUILD-PROMPT-eslifier-filter.md and build it. CRITICAL: verify the detection against a real ESLifier output folder + a live Missing Masters scan FIRST (disabled-count lesson) — don't ship a guessed trace. v1 = Settings ESLifier output-folder path + Nexus helper link, and the Missing Masters ON-by-default toggle that downgrades ESLifier-traced files from critical to warning (surfaced, not hidden). Update config.example.json for both new fields. Handoff with what the real ESLifier→Vortex deploy actually looked like and which scan signal the false positive fired on.

items.title: Clear stale end-of-flow banner on Preview re-arm
items.prompt: In Update Collection: re-doing Apply Ignores via Preview doesn't clear the stale end-of-flow completion banner until Apply re-succeeds. Wire callout-clearing into the Preview re-arm so the banner clears the moment the step is re-armed. Pre-existing minor issue; not blocking.
